title: Owned MC: transformation sequence for 2(x − 1)^2 + 5
stem_student: Starting from y = x^2, which sequence produces y = 2(x − 1)^2 + 5? A) Translate 1 right, stretch vertically by 2, translate 5 up. B) Translate 1 left, stretch vertically by 2, translate 5 up. C) Stretch vertically by 2, translate 1 left, translate 5 down. D) Translate 5 up, then 1 right, with no stretch.
stem_teacher: LLOVES-owned MC for A2.6 multi-step sketch planning. Order of vertical stretch vs horizontal translate is interchangeable for this form; A is the intended keyed sequence.
